what: Three cards hide behind the center one, and when the line reaches the screen center (50%), the side cards tilt ∓15° and unfold into place and sag 4.0625em down — position and tilt use .5s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1), appearance uses .5s sine. Scrolling back up folds them again

options.--fx-angle: Tilt of the two side cards (degrees, CSS variable), default 15deg
options.--fx-drop: Distance the two cards sag (CSS variable), default 4.0625em
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Three cards (children) — first and third unfold

from.where: detail.css .dt-growth (team detail ‹Points to grow› three cards)
